subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should post-core plugin compatibility checks trust the installed target OpenClaw package version before restart for both upgrades and downgrades?
rationale: This is the narrow source-of-truth choice that determines whether the PR is acceptable; code review can verify the handoff mechanics, but maintainer intent is needed for the upgrade-compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept installed-target handoff
options.body: Treat the package version that will run after restart as the compatibility host during post-core plugin update and convergence, while tracking the broader unknown-host runtime variant separately.

options.title: Require broader update proof
options.body: Ask for a full Windows or service-managed package update transcript before accepting the source-of-truth change.

options.title: Defer for runtime-host work
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether the unknown-host runtime reproduction should be fixed in the same branch.

recommendation.title: Accept installed-target handoff
recommendation.body: Treat the package version that will run after restart as the compatibility host during post-core plugin update and convergence, while tracking the broader unknown-host runtime variant separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent update-command and release/package-version history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the compatibility-source decision.
